basis: Current createArtTextures manifest with referenceArt present, plus both loaded atlas dimensions and all8 preloaded paintings. Sprite/background subframes share their source images and are not counted twice.
limitations: One-copy uncompressed RGBA pixel estimate, not measured process/device RAM. CPU decoded images/canvases and GPU copies may approximately double this subtotal. Excludes Phaser internal tiny textures, buffers, graphics geometry, icon-cache canvases/data URLs, transient painter canvases, browser overhead and driver allocation.
